info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Trade Banking By Param1-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to access specific trade banking project finance details using a unique identifier parameter. It serves as a vital resource for clients needing to monitor or evaluate trade financing projects. Typical consumers include financial analysts, project managers, and other stakeholders within banking institutions looking to retrieve project-specific data efficiently. By leveraging this endpoint, users can gain insights into project performance and financing structures, enhancing decision-making processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the details of a specific project finance resource identified by its unique identifier. It provides comprehensive information about the resource and its current status within the trade banking framework.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve project finance details for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. It should include any necessary parameters for filtering or fetching the relevant project finance information.

200.description: Successful retrieval of project finance details.
